title: Implement V4 project identity and atomic state transactions
goal: Add deterministic project binding, confined atomic state writes and fail-closed prepared-transaction recovery to the V4 host.
acceptanceCriteria: The same canonical TargetRoot binds idempotently to one deterministic project instance and different targets do not collide.
PackageRoot, TargetRoot, StateRoot and EvidenceRoot are canonical, link-free and mutually safe for their declared mutability.
State writes use prepared/applied journals and same-directory atomic replacement.
Recovery applies only a hash-matching prepared payload and marks drifted or missing payloads incomplete.
Experimental state commands do not change the seven stable CLI command identities.
P0/P1 and current V3 validation remain green with no active workflow or remote change.
